text: Redmond Rovers build an attack from their own half near the center circle and move the ball forward with a series of short and long passes along the center and left flank. The ball reaches Rory Mensah about 27 metres from Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the far end. Receiving a medium-distance pass from Kian Coleman, Mensah shoots with his foot and scores, leveling the score at 1-1 in the 37th minute.
